title: Oscar and the Asset
author: Kestrel Blackwood
blurb: Ivo Oyelaran, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
